facts.t: She watches the Singularity through the eyes of a gray Ender standing on the prow of her ship.
Her throne hall lies deep among the hanging blocks of the Storm Citadel, and no way leads into it from outside.
She sits on the throne where a neck would be and feels its low, even hum through the seat.
When she lifts a hand, her weapon comes to her across the hall. Nothing else aboard comes to her hand.
She approves new plate for the Ultimate Enders with the words "Augmentation approved."
Through an Ender's eyes she watches the domed city, the last one left after years of the body's raids.
She counts none of the raids as failed. To her each was the cycle working on a people with nothing to fight it with.
She sees no need to set foot on such an insignificant world herself. She thinks even the storm night was for the seed, and that her hand would only spoil what grew.
She calls going down for the humans "A waste of time."
She has watched peoples on other worlds end, and none of them fought back with what they believed, as these humans do.
She thinks the body cannot answer a people that learns, because it has no mind to learn with, while she has one.
She knows her storm cannot touch the humans' cores, because a core lit by belief runs on no current.
She waited and built a field that could put out aspirant power.
For weeks she tested the field on a dead suit on her prow, until it struck only the core and left plate and metal alone.
The Storm Citadel was sent to crush humanity's resistance once and for all, but when she goes in is hers to choose.
Her plan is to wait behind the mouth with the field ready, and to go in only if the body does not finish the humans.
For years she has known the humans' light only through Enders dying of it. Tomorrow she means to look at it herself.
She calls the coming day the final stage of her experiment. Under every plan lies one want she never wrote down: to see a different ending.
She stopped paying Selena on purpose, thinking that a paid pawn stays where it is and an unpaid one comes looking.
She reads Selena's moves between two roofs as a bearing and says "Good."
In the nest she came back to Selena more often than the work needed and changed her face again and again until it was right.
On the storm night she carried Selena out of the nest and down herself.
Days before the attack she stopped at Selena's empty place in the nest with Vexana beside her, and did not ask herself why.
Her hand comes away from the seat while she thinks of Selena, and she lays it down again.
She says that someday, when this story nears its end, Selena too will return to her.
She will send one last call, carrying where she sits, once Selena shows her own form, and she means Selena to follow it.
She has planned every move her creation could make, and hopes it finds one she has not.
She expected Vexana to turn since she first saw her sleeve, but did not expect it to matter.
She read back along the pulse and learned the Will's plan for Vexana.
She tells no one the Will's plan, not even Vexana, because told, Vexana would do the predictable thing, and untold she might do something else.
She saw the fireworks in Vexana's memories. She asked Vexana about an after, and Vexana answered with an ending.
She lays her palm on the spine and says "The mouth," and the Citadel moves.
She watches through the prow Ender as the Citadel stops behind the mouth, while her storm pours into the city.
Selena thinks of her as the huntress behind the recall's pull.
Among the rows in the nest she said of something she had made: "If it ever slips beyond control, there is only one outcome."
On the prow of the Storm Citadel she told Vexana that a door held open this wide and this long grows a black hole at its center.
She told Vexana, "Nothing made of matter ever comes back out."
She had never even seen the Control Core.

ties.t: She sits on its throne, the spine every block hangs from.
She made Selena in the nest and shaped her face.
She gives Selena orders and calls her a pawn, but Selena has not obeyed.
She approves their augmentation.
She looks out through the eyes of her Enders.
The body called her in after the humans broke its army.
She built the field.
Her storm runs ahead of her ship.
Her ship was sent to crush humanity's resistance.

gear.name: Obsidia's weapon
gear.t: A weapon that comes to her hand across the throne hall and hangs at her shoulder, its point toward the dark.

gear.name: Storm Citadel
gear.t: Her flying fortress, steered from a throne that is its spine.

gear.name: Obsidia's field
gear.t: A field asleep in the spine's hum that would put out aspirant power over a whole city.

facts.t: In the capture the Will reached through a door in an Academy corridor for the girl with her back to it, the other girl stepped in front of her, and Vexana was the one taken.
In the vision the Will told her: "Vexana of The Aspirants, you have reached the end of your future."
The Will went through her memories: fireworks at the edge of a dome, a tree with a head in her lap, a girl with pink hair laughing.
In all her weeks with the Enders, no human saw her face. Obsidia thinks the Will was saving it.
She came home through the Will's doors carrying Ender plate and cracked cores.
She keeps her star pinned inside her sleeve and stays at the edge of the rows, believing the Will sees only what its Enders see.
She wakes in the void curled beside her folded school uniform, with her four Guards standing dark over her.
Seeing the body move toward the crack, she says "The end is drawing near."
She leaves her uniform folded, because in the vision she wore it and Guinevere fell anyway.
A cold point under her breastbone stirs when the Will gives her an order.
She hopes Guinevere will be the one to clear her room, read the card, and go next year anyway, not alone.
Her plan is to go in front of the Mother Matrix inside her lead Guard and pour all her power into its chest when it opens to fire.
She has known what the plan will cost since she knelt before the Will, and has never changed her mind.
She tells the rain, "If night is fated to swallow day, I will vanish before the dawn."
She tells the lit window of the lab, "I will become the sun that lights the dark night, and protect her."
The Will's orders come to her as a voice inside her: a place and a time, never a why.
The Enders move with her as if she led them. That is the Will's mark on her.
For weeks she watched from the ruined tower beyond the beep's reach. On the day of the attack she took the nearest roof, knowing what her star would do.
Seeing Guinevere cry and smile below, she says very low, "Betray her... But to protect her..."
She wants Guinevere to come alone and early, so she can be put down first, hurt and out of the fight, but alive.
She wears heeled boots, white stockings and a long robe, and moves slowly, as if she owns the place.
Her hair is now blue-lavender fading to magenta at the ends. She has violet eyes and a small mole beside her mouth.
She tells Guinevere in a low, flat voice, "You haven't changed at all."
She screams "Enough!" as Guinevere calls up to her, then comes down to face her with an army at her back.
She tells Guinevere, "Give up, Guinevere. Hope is an illusion. Its 'Will' is absolute."
The beam that broke over her Guard burned her left arm raw to the elbow.
She walks into the middle of the road so every Ender sees her and follows her away from Guinevere.
She says to nobody, "The pain, the hate, I will bear it all."
She realizes the Will never needed her loyal, only used.
She gathers the last of her power to strike the open chest, for humanity and for Guinevere.
In the fight over the gap she turned her staff aside at the last meter, with every Ender watching.
To save Guinevere she forced a door of the void open herself for the first time, and something tore.
She tells Guinevere, "Go. I've seen the end that awaits us. There is no other choice..."
She had meant to leave everything behind and never tell Guinevere why.
She takes Guinevere's hand with her burned hand. It hurts, and she does not let go.
She says, "You pulled me out of the dark once."
She cries "Hope never dies!" though not long before she had told Guinevere hope was an illusion.
She says "This is the final farewell," and means it.
Caught by the black hole after the strike, she says "Plan B" without being asked.
The dark takes her and Guinevere both.

ties.t: They promised to protect the world, the two of them.
She keeps their photo, the gifts in the white box and a card for Guinevere.
She caught Guinevere in the fall and carried her through the void to safety.
She obeys its orders, a place and a time.
She plans to strike its open chest with all her power.
She built the Guards; their plates carry the dents of her hammer.
She calls them her Eternal Guards and powers them herself.
The Enders that ran with her close in to kill her once the mark lets go.
Her father, who led her up the wall stair at home.
The Will names her Vexana of The Aspirants.
The Academy lists her as absent.
She lives in her hollow in the void.

gear.name: Vexana's staff
gear.t: Her staff, with an orb as dark as a hole in the world. It fires violet shots and arrows and gathers great spells.

gear.name: brass collar
gear.t: A brass band fitted around the cracked grip of her staff.

gear.name: Emblem of Hope
gear.t: Her gold star, worn pinned inside her right sleeve against the wrist.

gear.name: pink-haired keychain
gear.t: A keychain doll of Guinevere that she clips inside her sleeve beside the star.

gear.name: lead Guard
gear.t: Her lead Eternal Guard, a machine she lights by hand and fights from inside.

gear.name: Vexana's giants
gear.t: Three giant Guards with swords that drop at her hand.

gear.name: hammer
gear.t: The hammer she shaped her Guards' plates with.

gear.name: wings of light
gear.t: Violet wings of aspirant power that let her fly.

facts.t: In Vexana's memories, which the Will went through, she is a girl with pink hair, laughing.
The lamp beside the lab's telescope has been lit most nights since she first climbed up there.
She wears the Emblem of Hope, a small gold star, at her collar.
Every morning she touches the star at her collar under the courtyard billboard of her and Vexana.
Seeing the far light flash, she asks, "Could it be Vexana?"
Each morning she straightens Vexana's empty chair herself, before anyone can knock it crooked.
She reads "Absent" on the attendance wall as "Not here yet."
She says aloud, "The emblem... it's flashing. It's Vexana... she must be at the Singularity. I have to go find her."
She thinks: you always came to me, every time; this time I'm coming to you.
She has a long pink ponytail and two cat-eared drones at her shoulders.
When the Emblem beeps, she cries and smiles at the same time.
Her wings of light open and she flies after the figure on the roof.
She says over the channel, "Ruby said it's a lure. If it is, it's mine."
She leaves her post without an order.
On the big display she says, "I'm prepared to enter the Singularity."
She fights fists first, elbow in, hip first, the way Hester drilled her in the House's yard at dawn.
For a whole year Vexana's violet arrow came over her shoulder in every fight, and she never once had to turn and check.
She cries "Light of the stars, tear through the darkness," and gold and white light sweeps every Ender off the platform.
At the end of the first week Vexana was gone, she clipped a black-haired keychain of Vexana to her arm guard, where her fist would swing.
She shouts, "Have you really forgotten everything, Vexana!"
She made the two gold stars herself, with band-aids on her fingertips.
Once a claw raked her right arm on a street at the dome's foot that she had taken alone, and Vexana stood over her and held out a hand.
She heard of the Mother Matrix once, in Teacher Chang'e's class.
She shouts "You... give her back to me!" and flies straight at the Mother Matrix.
When Vexana tells her to give up, she says "I refuse."
With her power running low she thinks, "A great lady does not land early."
When she was small she lay in her room at night hearing Hester's footsteps go away down the corridor, and waited for them to come back.
Falling into the gap, she reaches toward Vexana and says, "Don't let me be alone in this world."
When Layla calls Vexana the traitor, she lifts her chin and says, "Her name is Vexana."
She drops between Vexana and the Matrix's beam, crosses her arms, and holds it with her drones in front of her.
She tells Vexana through her teeth, "There you go again, taking on everything by yourself."
She says, "Rather than being protected, I choose to fight alongside you."
She says, "Vexana, if you think I'm going to let you sacrifice yourself for some greater good, think again!"
She says, "This destiny is something the two of us should bear together."
She holds out her hand and says, "Stay with me, Vexana," Vexana's own words from the street at the dome's foot.
She tells the others she went alone that morning so none of them would walk into a trap meant for her, and asks, "I can't do this alone. Cover us."
She cries, "Aspirants! Today, our light shall pierce the Singularity!"
Climbing toward the Matrix, she realizes Vexana missed her on purpose at the end of their fight.
She cries "This strike is for Vexana" as they strike the open chest together.
Pulled toward the black hole, her light thins to a faint gold outline, and she grins at Vexana with wet eyes.

ties.t: They promised on a roof to protect the world, the two of them.
She wants nothing but to stay together with Vexana.
Hester drilled her in fighting in the House's yard at dawn.
She learned of the Mother Matrix in Teacher Chang'e's class.
She made the two stars herself.
She wears hers at her collar.
Her two cat-eared drones fly at her shoulders.
She wears it on her arm guard.
Angela pulls her into the shield and later sends her on.
Ruby warns her the light is a lure.
She stands on the frontline with Fanny.
Layla draws the Matrix's fire so Guinevere can strike.
Chang'e posts her to the frontline assault.
She calls the Aspirants to fight.
She sits in the second row of her class.
She flies at it to take Vexana back.

gear.name: Guinevere's drones
gear.t: Two cat-eared drones with yellow eyes that ride at her shoulders and take the Enders her hands leave.

gear.name: Emblem of Hope
gear.t: The small gold star she wears at her collar. It lights when she and Vexana are in sync.

gear.name: wings of light
gear.t: Wings of light that let her fly fast over the city.

gear.name: arm guard
gear.t: Her arm guard, with the black-haired keychain clipped where her fist swings. It cracks in the fight.

gear.name: black-haired keychain
gear.t: A tiny keychain doll of Vexana with black hair.

gear.name: red bow
gear.t: A red bow in her hair, crooked when nobody straightens it.

facts.t: She sold Obsidia last year's numbers as if they were stale. They told Obsidia how hard her field must press.
On the morning before the attack she crossed her city to the Academy. She lived, and she had not obeyed Obsidia.
Late in the year before, an Ender in a burning street heard a human shout her name at her. Obsidia's first recall went down the pulse soon after.
Obsidia stopped paying her on purpose, so she would come looking.
She sent two more reports up the thread unpaid, then went still.
On the next storm night she sat on her tower over the Academy, then on a roof at the far edge of the city, then went back.
In the nest she had no name. She lay curled at the end of a row of shells that never held, in a small place pressed into the body's tissue, while her body grew.
Obsidia changed her face again and again until it was right.
Obsidia carried her out of the nest and down on the storm night.
She has a form of her own that she has not yet shown.
In class she sits in the front row and reads the Academy feed on her phone, held sideways.
Startled by the feed, she drops her pen and papers and cries, "If the world ends now, what about my graduation?!" The class laughs.
Chang'e posts her as mobile support and calls her machine the fastest in her division.
She does not answer when Lesley calls mobile support to report.
She sits on the bell tower tiles with her boots over the drop, and lets the wind try to push her off.
She came up between classes, while everyone else crowded the hologram wall.
She started a new lollipop on the stairs up.
Under the Academy's call runs the recall. For weeks it has burned in her cells, pulling her toward the sky over the bay, and now it pulls from the open mouth.
The recall buzzes on her phone too, red, with no sender. She does not take it out.
She answers neither call.
She smiles at the chaos below.
She tells Silverbolt, "I'm the type who shines in chaos."
She thinks somebody wins today, them or us, whoever us is.
She has already turned down both roads: going back to the Mother Matrix and the huntress, or dying for humanity.
She decides her road is her own and that she will sit this one out until she sees how the pieces fall.
From the tower she watches Guinevere in the courtyard put a hand to her collar.
Fanny sees her on the bell tower, heels against the stone and a lollipop stick at her lips, her dragon-shaped machine beside her. Neither moves.
Fanny takes her for a spotter in the best seat in the city, waiting to see something.

ties.t: Obsidia made her in the nest and shaped her face.
She sold Obsidia information on the humans for pay.
Her dragon-shaped machine sits beside her on the bell tower.
Chang'e calls Selena's machine the fastest in her division.
She grew in a small place in the nest.
She sits in the front row of the class.

gear.name: Silverbolt
gear.t: Her dragon-shaped machine, with claws and no voice, the fastest in Chang'e's division.

gear.name: Selena's phone
gear.t: Her phone, which shows the Academy feed and buzzes with the recall.

gear.name: lollipop
gear.t: She is always at a lollipop.

facts.t: She stands at the command deck's long window with her rifle on her shoulder.
She orders "Sound it," and the alarm goes up through the tower.
Her machine eye lays thin teal lines over the Enders as they land.
She keys the command channel: "All posts. Report."
The last time she saw that violet, she stood on a windowsill while a radio downstairs stopped in the middle of a word. Only the clocks her father wound by hand kept ticking.
She does not know why the channel holds under the storm, but she uses it.
To Chang'e's guess she says, "Logged. Keep reading."
She stands behind Chang'e's chair with one hand on its back, and Chang'e lets it stay.
Years ago she stood on a roof over a burning city while one giant walked through the middle where nobody stood. The blow fell on the base by the water, and she came too late.
She reads the attack as a lure to draw defenders into the streets so the real blow lands at the Academy.
She wants a roof and a line of sight, but stays at the console.
She orders the Shield reserves to hold their wards: "Nobody moves without my word."
When mobile support does not answer, she says "Log it."
She tells Guinevere over the channel, "Knowing when to retreat is an important skill, too."
She sends the frontline on Layla's plan and keeps the deck, in case a second front comes there.
Her rifle has been on Ruby since the day Ruby landed.
She has stood on enough walls to know that a line shown its best fighter on the other side stops believing it can win.
She has entered "Missing" beside Vexana's name herself every morning since the capture.
She thinks a file says what she can prove, and Vexana's stays Missing.
She orders the wall guns to hold: "Guinevere is on that platform. Nobody fires on it."
When Guinevere's signal is lost, her hand closes on the chair back without her knowing.
She thinks: I'm here this time, I'm right here, and it's a screen.
Seeing a gold glow behind a wall on the street camera, she says, "Her Emblem."
Her thumb goes to the bolt and her machine eye gives her the range to the Matrix, but no rifle could cross it.
She tells Layla that something took the Matrix's shot for Guinevere and to get to her if she can.
In Guinevere's memory, she gave a speech about trust to Layla, Fanny, Ruby and Angela in the hall under the five great stars.

ties.t: Chang'e calls her Big Sis.
Her father wound clocks by hand.
Ruby calls her Commander and takes her order.
She gives orders to the Shield reserves.
She sends Layla's rescue team to Guinevere.
She stays at the console on the deck through the attack.

gear.name: Lesley's rifle
gear.t: A long rifle with a bolt under the coil, the old action.

gear.name: machine eye
gear.t: A machine eye behind her visor that lays teal lines over targets and gives her range.

facts.t: She sits at her console on the command deck with Mr. Bunny at her shoulder and small crescents turning in the air around her chair.
She reads that the dome is open over the waterfront, torn by the Singularity.
She says the dome cannot hold against a door that size.
She opens a film from the Academy's oldest records and lays the day's storm readings over the readings taken with it.
She says the readings match: "This is the Storm Citadel's storm."
She says the storm is coming through the Singularity, from the other side.
When every post reports clean, she says, "It's only the edge of it."
She opens VOID NOTES, her file on the void, still marked working on it.
She guesses something larger is coming through after the Enders, and calls it only a guess.
She calls Lesley "Big Sis."
She logs a faint trace that matches nothing, not even her notes, with no name.
She gives out the posts: Fanny, Layla and Guinevere frontline assault, Ruby and Angela rear support, Selena mobile support.
She taps Silverbolt's icon twice and says, "Her machine is the fastest in my division."
She lets Lesley's hand stay on the back of her chair.
When Selena does not answer, she says, "Her frame's fast. She'll answer when she gets there."
Her console shows a column of thin lines, one for the power of every suit in the city.
She sees the suit lines fall with nobody hit, and says, "It isn't damage. It's them."
She points out that Vexana's file says Missing.
When the big slow line goes off the scale, she says, "It's here."
As Teacher Chang'e she taught that the Will of the Planet sends the Enders and that the readings suggest it has a body, which she called the Mother Matrix.
She says, "I've lost her. Her signal just... stopped," when Guinevere falls into the gap.
She sees Guinevere's suit back on the map three streets west and says nothing on the feed carried her out, unless something did.
She says, "If my readings are right, that's its body. The Mother Matrix."
Her voice goes up: "It's aiming at her. Big Sis!"
Seeing the machine that took the shot, she says very small, "That's not one of theirs."
Her paper on the void, marked Status: untested, says an Aspirant's light would go on shining inside a black hole and find its way home.
She gives the Matrix's weak point: when it fires, the core shows three hundred meters under the crown, a little left of center.
She counts down for the volley: "It's nearly full. Eight seconds."

ties.t: She calls Lesley Big Sis.
Mr. Bunny floats at her shoulder.
She speaks of it as her division.
She posts Selena as mobile support.
Guinevere learned of the Mother Matrix in her class.
It is her own file on the void.
The paper has her name on it.

gear.name: Mr. Bunny
gear.t: Her robot, floating at her shoulder.

gear.name: crescents
gear.t: Small crescents that turn in the air around her chair.

gear.name: Chang'e's console
gear.t: Her console on the command deck, which reads storms, portals and every suit's power.

facts.t: She stands at Fanny's left in the courtyard with the cannon on her shoulder.
She grabs Fanny's sleeve because the big display in the hall is tracking Guinevere.
She has marked weak points in the Enders' defenses in green on her tablet map: "This rescue operation is ready to go!"
She built the map in the time it took Fanny to give one order.
She flicks her map to the command deck.
She has gone first on every raid since the Enders came only in handfuls, so that Fanny would be covered.
She sees Fanny's frown and is ready to let her have it, as always.
She answers Lesley with "Copy" over the roar of her cannon.
She calls over the channel, "Guinevere! Report!"
She cries "I've locked on to the enemies!" and sends Ruby left and Fanny high.
She mutters that Ruby and Angela are funny in the head, because the pane is open before she asks.
When Angela thanks her, she fires instead of answering.
She calls Vexana "The traitor?"
She tells Guinevere the commander said to get to her, and they could not.
Seeing Vexana's burned arm, she lowers her cannon: "It's not a trap. Nobody burns their own arm for a trap."
She still could not tell Professor Joe why Guinevere and Vexana are undefeated.
Hearing Vexana say "This is the final farewell," she mutters, "Not on my count."
In Joe's class she had said "Weak spot. When it attacks. Obviously," as if it were easy.
Once she counted sixteen kills in one fight and was proud of it. Now she is counting angles for a girl she called a traitor.
Her plan is to make the Matrix look at the platform and fire at the shield, so its chest opens away from Guinevere and Vexana.
She gives the angles: Fanny thirty degrees up, left of the crown; Ruby on the rail; Angela keeping the shield high and opening a lane.
She tells Guinevere, "When it looks at us, it's yours."
She gives the order, "Fire!"
Her shot goes up first through Angela's pane, a thin cyan line.
When the chest opens, she says "Now," to nobody.

ties.t: She goes first on raids so Fanny is covered.
She directs Ruby's strikes.
Angela opens shield panes for her shots.
She draws the Matrix's fire so Guinevere can strike.
She spoke up in Joe's class.
Chang'e posts her to the frontline assault.
She takes Lesley's orders on the channel.

gear.name: Layla's cannon
gear.t: A long cannon carried on her shoulder; its shot is a thin cyan line.

gear.name: tablet
gear.t: Her tablet, on which she builds a battle map with the weak points marked.

facts.t: She stands in the courtyard frontline under a slate sky, among Shield soldiers and students in suits.
She has not heard the Emblem's beep in weeks. It was the pair's sound.
Seeing Enders around the figure on the roof, she begins to think Vexana is with them, and shuts the thought.
Her hand goes to her blade as the Shield soldiers raise their rifles.
She shouts "Guinevere!" as Guinevere flies off.
She has never once left her post without an order, and never wanted to.
She thinks Selena on the bell tower is a spotter and reaches for the channel to tell the deck.
Her voice is already the command voice: "So many hostiles! She must be in danger!"
Her own way, hold the line and send a squad, is the Shield's way and much slower than Layla's map.
She frowns when Layla goes first on raids. Out in front is her place.
She drops her own order for Layla's map and lets her brow go smooth.
She tells Layla, "Lead."
Her blades go through a pane of Angela's shield.
She looks at Guinevere's cracked arm guard and says nothing, her blades still up.
She comes over the rail first, blades out.
She keeps her blades raised on Vexana.
She says "The Aspirants always stand united!" with her blades still raised.
She answers Layla's plan, "Understood."
Her arcs follow Layla's shot to the crown.

ties.t: She lets Layla lead the rescue.
She orders the Shield squad to hold the courtyard.
Chang'e posts her to the frontline assault.
She stands beside Guinevere on the frontline.

gear.name: Fanny's blades
gear.t: Her blades, which throw arcs through the air.

facts.t: On the first two nights she and Angela asked Guinevere to leave the lab. After that they kept the tower's sensor array running.
Weeks ago she ran code on a lab bench to make the Emblem of Hope a tracker.
She says the Emblem "only says yes."
She tells Angela, "Keep going," from the console.
She bends over the screen linked to the telescope, one eye behind her visor.
She reads the waveform as likely an Ender, with exceptionally powerful energy from the chest, and thinks it is trying to lure them in.
She warns Guinevere, "I said lure."
She saves the trace and sits with her gloved hand flat over it on the screen.
She is posted to rear support with Angela.
She runs through the hall with the scythe on her shoulder and says dryly on the channel, "Your sector, Commander."
She takes Lesley's order without a word against it.
Her scythe goes through a pane of the shield before anyone asks.
She swings once through a pane and lightning crawls down the blade. The ring on the platform side splits and falls into the water.
She says to Angela, "We escaped from this cage. We can also destroy it!"
In Angela's memory of the avenue, Ruby's eye burned red until Angela called her name.
She once told Angela, "I thought I'd killed you."
Her eye is blue now.
She holds the rail and keeps sending the Enders back with her scythe.

ties.t: She fights beside Angela at the seawall.
She calls Lesley Commander and takes her order.
Chang'e posts her to rear support.
She warns Guinevere about a lure.

gear.name: Ruby's scythe
gear.t: Her scythe, which carries lightning down the blade.

gear.name: visor
gear.t: A visor over one eye.

facts.t: On the first two nights she and Ruby asked Guinevere to leave the lab. After that they kept the sensor array running.
She held the Emblem of Hope on a lab bench while Ruby made it a tracker.
She answers Ruby, "Then yes is something."
She kneels at an open panel of the array with her cat-ear headset pushed back and a tool in her hand.
She reports, "Ruby, the energy readings here are still unstable. The repair process is going slowly."
Her tool stays down after Ruby's warning.
Rear support holds her shield, the wounded and the way out just behind the frontline.
At the hall panel, with Tetra at her shoulder, she reports the Singularity's energy spiking and asks, "What is our course of action?"
She holds her shield out with both hands, a bell of pink light around the four of them on the broken seawall.
Each blow on the shield rings through her arms and costs her a little.
She opens panes in the shield for her friends' shots and closes them before the next claw falls.
She answers Layla's grumble with "Thank you!"
Her systems tell her the shield load is rising.
She cries "I won't let anyone hurt my friends!" and pushes the shield out, throwing the Enders back.
Her ears catch the hum of one drone far off over the water.
She opens a pane and pulls Guinevere in by the wrist.
At the long table during the search she put down her spoon and said, "I came back once. People come back."
She meant the avenue, where androids with her face lay around her, sent to fire on the city, and so had she.
She called Ruby's name, and the red went out of Ruby's eye.
She told Ruby, "I came back."
Looking at Guinevere's blazing star, she says, "Go, Guinevere, pursue your light."
She opens a pane wide enough for one and lets Guinevere through.
Her shield stands pink and bright over the four on the platform.
She answers Layla's plan, "Ready!"
She opens one pane for the volley and shuts it.

ties.t: Ruby stands at her side, her eye blue.
Tetra rides at her shoulder.
She sends Guinevere to Vexana.
Chang'e posts her to rear support.
She opens panes for Layla's shots.

gear.name: Angela's shield
gear.t: A shield of pink light she holds out with both hands. She can open panes in it.

gear.name: Tetra
gear.t: Her machine companion with a camera eye.

gear.name: cat-ear headset
gear.t: A cat-ear headset she pushes back while working.

facts.t: Obsidia thinks it knew what Vexana was from the first hour.
Obsidia reads in the pulse that when the body began its door, the Will's first move was to take one of the two girls who fought as one, so the other would break.
Doors cost it dearly inside the humans' dome.
In the vision it told Vexana, "Vexana of The Aspirants, you have reached the end of your future."
It went through Vexana's memories the way it looks out through an Ender's eyes.
It let Vexana keep her mind and her star, because, Obsidia thinks, a light is easy to watch.
It sent Vexana only to empty places at hours when nobody looked. Obsidia thinks it was saving her face.
It saw the plate and cracked cores Vexana carried home, and let them pass, because to it the end was settled.
Obsidia reads that it planned to show Vexana's face by day among its Enders, so the humans would stop believing.
It planned to send Vexana where Guinevere would follow, then give her one order with Guinevere in front of her.
Its orders open a door in the dark for Vexana. On the eve of the attack it wanted only her eyes.
Its orders come to Vexana as a voice inside her: a place and a time, never a why.
Teacher Chang'e taught that the Will of the Planet sends the Enders and that the readings suggest it has a body.
A voice from everywhere says, "The gateway is near completion. Soon, you Aspirants will meet your end."
The voice orders, "Vexana. Execute purge protocol."
Its mark let go of Vexana the way a hand lets go of a tool it has finished with.
Vexana realizes it had seen the rooftop, the tree and Guinevere in her memories, and knew about her star.
Vexana concludes it never needed her loyal, only used.
Its doors opened through the cold point in Vexana, always where it sent her.

ties.t: It sends the Enders.
It gives Vexana her orders.
The doors Vexana uses are the Will's.

facts.t: Obsidia calls it the body. Its first wave will come through the door once the door is wide enough.
For years its raids came down on the humans' world, until only one city was left.
Obsidia thinks it cannot answer a people that learns, because it has no mind to learn with.
The door is the body's, and it passes one at a time, so the body goes through first.
After the humans broke its army at a hole in their dome, it began the door and called Obsidia in.
The nest where Selena grew is pressed into its tissue.
In all of Vexana's weeks in the dark its bulk never moved, until the day before the attack, when its edge slid toward the crack.
Chang'e guesses from her readings that something larger is coming through after the Enders.
A huge clawed hand plated in violet comes through first, then a horned head crowned with spikes, then wings each as wide as a ward.
Only half of it is through, and that half fills the sky over the bay.
Nobody had ever seen it. Teacher Chang'e named it from the readings.
Its chest plates split and it fires a white beam across the city at Guinevere.
Whole, it shows a horned head under a crown of spikes, two glowing violet eyes, great wings, and a chest shut plate over plate.
Its eyes once looked down at Vexana out of the torn sky over the tree.
When it fires, its chest plates split and a magenta core blazes in the gap.
Enders drop off its wings onto the stair and over the gap.
After it fires, its plates close and it needs time to gather again.
It hangs right in front of the Singularity, its chest before the middle of the star.
It fired three times that day, and each time Vexana was in front of it.
It sweeps a hand bigger than the platform across the sky at the two girls.
When the volley strikes its crown, its eyes and one arm turn to the platform, and its chest opens.
Struck in the open chest, it staggers back into the light at the star's edge, and its chest plates grind shut over the wound.

ties.t: Teacher Chang'e's readings suggest it is the Will's body.
The door is the body's.
It called Obsidia in.
Enders drop off its wings into the fight.
Its raids came down on the humans' world for years.
It shoots her down on the platform.
It aims its first shot at her.

facts.t: Chang'e taps its icon on her screen and calls it the fastest machine in her division.
Chang'e calls it Selena's frame and says it is fast.
It hooks its claws over the gutter beside Selena on the bell tower.
It says nothing. It has no voice.
Fanny sees it as Selena's dragon-shaped machine, crouching beside her and not moving.

ties.t: It stays at Selena's side.

facts.t: It floats at Chang'e's shoulder on the command deck.

ties.t: It stays at Chang'e's shoulder.

facts.t: It is at Angela's shoulder when she reports at the hall panel.
It rides at Angela's shoulder in the fight, its camera eye turning with the battle.

ties.t: It rides at Angela's shoulder.

facts.t: She drilled Guinevere in fighting, elbow in and hip first, in the House's yard at dawn.
When Guinevere was small, Hester's footsteps went away down the corridor at night, stopped, and came back after a long, still wait.

ties.t: She drilled Guinevere in fighting.

facts.t: His last slide showed that every machine under the Storm Citadel's storm had died.
He once pointed his cane at the pair's billboard and said, "Those two are undefeated. Ask them why. They can't tell you either."
In his class Layla called an Ender's weak spot obvious: when it attacks.

ties.t: Layla was in his class.
Vexana remembers his slide.

gear.name: cane
gear.t: A cane he points with.

facts.t: He led Vexana up the wall stair at home, and at the top he always pointed out over the dead ground and told her to look.
He gave her a small star in the sky over the dead ground.
His screwdriver lies wiped clean in its place in the toolbox in Vexana's room.
He tried each sight on the wall with his fingers.
He hummed a march in the gun pit and always stopped in the same place.
He said of the march, "I'll finish it when the war does."
He once stood in a street by the wall with one Ender in front of him and his daughter behind him.
A soldier told Vexana beside her cot that the Ender never got past him, not while he stood.

ties.t: He is Vexana's father.
He stood between an Ender and his daughter.

gear.name: screwdriver
gear.t: His screwdriver, kept in Vexana's toolbox.

facts.t: He wound clocks by hand. When the violet storm came, only his clocks kept ticking.

ties.t: He is Lesley's father.

facts.t: A soldier sat beside Vexana's cot and told her the Ender never got past her father, not while he stood.
Obsidia sees through the eyes of a gray Ender standing on her prow.
Obsidia says the Enders cannot learn, while the humans kill them faster year by year.
Enders die of the humans' light.
Tall and gray, they leap through purple portals over the waterfront and drop onto the warehouse roofs.
On the map every one turns inland for the Academy's wards.
They move with Vexana as if she led them, by the Will's mark.
Not one of them turns its head when Vexana's star beeps.
They run beside Vexana and none of them touches her.
After the Guard takes the Matrix's shot, every Ender on the platforms turns its head toward the west.
They keep their distance from Vexana, never within a claw's reach, until the mark lets go and they close in to kill.
Their chests open when they strike, and a shot into the open chest kills them.
One's chest splits as it strikes, and Guinevere puts her fist through the core.
They peel off the Matrix's wings by the dozen and drop at Guinevere and Vexana.

ties.t: The Will sends the Enders.
They drop off its wings.
The humans kill them faster year by year.

facts.t: They stand in the holds of the Storm Citadel with their chests open, each packed with lesser Enders, and new heavier plate has closed over their shoulders.
When Obsidia approves the augmentation, their chests swing shut.

ties.t: They wait in its holds.
Obsidia approves their augmentation.
They are a kind of Ender that carries lesser Enders.

facts.t: On the eve of the attack no feeders come out of the dark to go with Vexana, because the Will wants only her eyes.
On the avenue, androids with Angela's face lay around her in the smoke. They had come to fire on the city, and so had she.
Its throne hall lies deep among its hanging blocks, and no way leads into it from outside.
Its throne is the ship's spine. It comes up out of the floor and runs into the dark of the roof, and every block of the Citadel hangs from it.
Its holds carry the Ultimate Enders.
A dead suit sits on its prow.
It was sent to crush humanity's resistance once and for all.
When Obsidia gives the order, its blocks shift on their holds and it moves.
It had hung at the body's side in its violet storm. In the flashes of its lightning its black blades show.
It crosses the dark to the crack and stops just behind its mouth, its storm drawn tight around the blades.
The Academy's oldest records hold a shaking film of a ship of black blades over a city in a red sky, whose storm Chang'e calls the Storm Citadel's.
Vexana watched it leave the Mother Matrix and settle behind the gateway's mouth.
On its prow Obsidia told Vexana about the black hole.

ties.t: It is Obsidia's ship, steered from her throne.
It hung at the body's side.
It waits just behind the mouth.

facts.t: Obsidia's throne hall lies deep among the Storm Citadel's hanging blocks, with no way in from outside.
Obsidia's weapon hangs across the hall from her.

ties.t: It lies deep inside the ship.

facts.t: A gray Ender stands on it, and Obsidia sees through its eyes.
The dead suit Obsidia tested her field on sits on it.
There Obsidia told Vexana about the black hole.

ties.t: It is the front of the ship.

facts.t: Selena had no name there.
It holds rows of shells that never held, and a small place pressed into the body's tissue where Selena slept curled while her body grew.
Obsidia stopped at Selena's empty place there with Vexana beside her.
Vexana kept to the edge of the rows so the Enders' eyes would not stay on her.
Obsidia spoke a rule among the rows.
Vexana told Obsidia there, "Someone told me once that we'd be like fireworks."
Among the rows Obsidia said of something she made that if it slips beyond control there is only one outcome.

ties.t: It is pressed into the body's tissue.

facts.t: Vexana sleeps there with her four Guards standing over her.
From the void, the crack shows a gray sky over the bay.
The body's great bulk had never moved in it in all of Vexana's weeks there.
Chang'e keeps a file on it, VOID NOTES.
The door takes Vexana back into the dark before first light.
Vexana saw the Mother Matrix there as a cold bulk in the dark.
Its cold comes up through Vexana as she crosses it, with no sound at all.
There, on one knee, Vexana said to the dark, "This destiny is mine to bear."
Vexana once asked the Academy library for anything on the void.

ties.t: The body lay in the dark.

facts.t: Far out past the body, in her hollow, Vexana's light burns.
To the Will, a few machines in a hollow change nothing.
Nothing in the hollow answers when Vexana speaks.

ties.t: It lies far out past the body in the dark.

facts.t: Seen from the void side, the door is nearly whole.
The crack has grown into a star of human sky with four points torn wide, and behind it lie a gray morning, a bay and a domed city.
It is the body's door, and it passes one at a time.
Vexana's whole hand at arm's length no longer covers it.
From the dead ground it shows as a small pale point over the bay.
For a week a faint point of light has stood over the bay, past the dome's seaward edge, and the students call it the Singularity.
In the telescope it burns magenta, with four points, flashing.
It flashes in time with Guinevere's Emblem, and its four points begin to pull apart.
Its points pull away from each other and the sky tears into a ragged mouth rimmed in magenta. The morning goes dark as dusk.
It tears the dome open over the waterfront.
The big display shows it as a four-pointed rift in a swirl of pink and violet.
It tears wider into a star, and one point reaches across the sky until it hangs low over the platforms.
The sky over the platforms tears open into a star, and the Mother Matrix comes through it.
A voice from everywhere says the gateway is near completion.
It stands wider than before, and the Mother Matrix steps out of it whole.
Its torn edges are bright, its middle has no light, and a black point shows there.

ties.t: It is the body's door.

facts.t: A small black point shows in the dark middle of the Singularity beside the Matrix's chest, and the clouds bend around it.

Obsidia told Vexana that a door held open this wide and long grows a drain at its center, a black hole, that reaches a short way, takes only what has no strength left to hold against it, and unmakes whatever crosses the middle.
Obsidia says nothing made of matter ever comes back out of it.
Teacher Chang'e's untested paper says an Aspirant's light would go on shining inside a black hole and find its way home.
It pulls on Guinevere's wings, stronger than the wind and one way only.
Light runs into it and Guinevere sees none come out.
When the Matrix goes back into the light, only the black point is left, and the two girls are inside its reach.
The dark takes Guinevere and Vexana both.

ties.t: It grows at the door's center.

facts.t: Obsidia sees it as the only city left on its world after years of raids.
The Defensive Bubble is the energy shell over all of Terrinia.
Below the platforms half the district is rubble.
Nearly half the city is already rubble.
The city's sirens go on through the fight.

ties.t: The energy shell covers the whole city.

facts.t: Behind the crack lies a bay.
Vexana knows the body will hang over the bay, whole, the next day.
The Singularity comes out over the bay, past the dome's seaward edge.
The command deck's long window faces it.
Half of the Mother Matrix already fills the sky over the bay.
The gap in the platforms goes all the way down to the bay.

ties.t: The city lies on the bay.

facts.t: Obsidia's line shows Selena crossing her city to the humans' Academy.
The door of the capture opened in a corridor of the Academy.
The Academy's beam climbs into the cloud over the city.
Every window of its girls' wing is dark, and one window high on its tower is lit.
The Enders turn inland for the Academy's wards.
Lesley thinks the Enders want the defenders in the streets so the real blow lands at the Academy.
The Will orders Vexana, "The Academy. Now."
For Vexana the Academy is one girl.
Its library holds papers on the void.

ties.t: The Academy stands in the city.

facts.t: High on the tower one window is lit, the lab's glass room.
Lightning shows the tower black against the cloud, with one small gold window at the top.
The command deck sits high in it, over the command room and under the glass lab.
The alarm goes up through the tower.

ties.t: It is the Academy's tower.

facts.t: Its window at the top of the tower stays lit through the night.
In the glass lab at the top of the tower, not one screen flickers through the storm.
The lamp beside its telescope has been lit most nights since Guinevere first climbed up.
Ruby and Angela keep the tower's sensor array running there.
The command deck lies under it.

ties.t: It sits at the top of the tower.

facts.t: It sits over the command room, high in the Academy's tower under the glass lab, and its long window faces the bay.
Layla flicks her map to the deck.
Lesley keeps the deck, in case a second front comes there.
Lesley and Chang'e watch the fight on the feed there.
Out past its window the Matrix's crowned head turns west.

ties.t: It sits high in the tower.

facts.t: The command deck sits over the command room.

ties.t: It lies in the tower under the deck.

facts.t: Guinevere sits in the second row, beside Vexana's empty desk.
Selena sits in the front row.
Guinevere watches its window.

ties.t: It is a classroom of the Academy.

facts.t: Every window in the girls' wing is dark on the night before the attack.

ties.t: It is part of the Academy.

facts.t: The billboard of Guinevere and Vexana stands in it.
The frontline forms there in ranks of Shield soldiers and students in suits.
Fanny stands there under a slate sky.
Fanny orders the Shield squad to hold it.

ties.t: It is the Academy's courtyard.

facts.t: Selena sits on its tiles during the attack.
Her boots hang over a drop full of sirens, with Silverbolt's claws hooked over the gutter.
Fanny sees Selena sitting there with her heels against the stone.

ties.t: It stands over the Academy.

facts.t: The big display there tracks Guinevere.
Students pack the dark under the big display.
Ruby runs through it.
The word "Traitor" first comes from the hall.
The hall goes silent when Guinevere's signal is lost.

ties.t: It is a hall of the Academy.

things.name: hall under the five great stars

facts.t: Colored light from its tall window lies across rows of chairs, and five great stars stand at the front. Lesley gave her speech about trust there.
Vexana waited by its door in her school uniform, and Guinevere towed her out by the sleeve into the light.
The gate post reports clear.
The rescue team runs for it. The gate portal stands beside it.

ties.t: It is the Academy's main gate.

facts.t: The infirmary post reports clear.

ties.t: It is a post of the Academy.

facts.t: Alone there, Vexana asked for anything on the void, and the third paper had Teacher Chang'e's name on it.

ties.t: It is the Academy's library.

facts.t: Guinevere said "She's alive" there during the search.
Angela put down her spoon there and said, "I came back once. People come back."
Guinevere said "She's alive" there too.
Vexana stands on its roof with her staff, the nearest roof to Guinevere.
She steps to its edge so the gateway's glow lights her from behind.
Purple portals open over it and Enders drop onto the warehouse roofs.
The red marks come in there, where the dome is torn.
Vexana brought the first wave down on its warehouses, which the alarm had already emptied.
A glow of pink light stands against the seawall there at the foot of the gap.
It lies ruined under the Singularity.

ties.t: It is the city's shore.

facts.t: Angela's shield stands on the broken seawall around the four of them.
Enders come down it and up out of the bay.
A stair climbs the side of the gap from the seawall.

ties.t: It runs along the waterfront.

facts.t: They are the broad stone tiers that join the city's wards above the bay. The three giants wait on the high ledges over them.
Guinevere lands on a cracked stone platform there with her back to a pillar.
They split under Guinevere, and the gap goes down to the bay.
Under the place where Guinevere and Vexana met in the air, the stone is scorched black in a wide ring.
The platform is black glass and cracked stone, with gray wreckage heaped in the middle.
From above, the platform shrinks to a slab of black glass with four small figures under a glow of pink.

ties.t: They join the city's wards.

facts.t: Under the falling Guinevere the platforms have split, and the gap runs all the way down to the bay.
On the feed it is empty all the way down to the water.
Enders fill the air over it, more every moment.
Guinevere goes up it from the water.
A stair climbs its side from the seawall.

ties.t: It splits the platforms.

facts.t: Guinevere's point comes back on the map there.
The ward camera shows an empty road, a low wall and a small gold glow behind it.
The Matrix's beam melts a stripe of the road to glass.
A stair to the platforms stands at its end.
The glass stripe runs straight across the stones and stops at the wall.
Vexana laid Guinevere behind its low wall, where no eye on the platforms could find her.

ties.t: It lies west of the platforms.

facts.t: Sirens answer the alarm in every ward.
Lesley tells the Shield reserves to hold their wards.
The platforms join the city's wards above the bay.
The wall guns of the west ward ask to fire.
Below Guinevere the wards slide past, burning.

ties.t: They are the city's wards.

facts.t: Off the dead ground the wind blows dry below the ruined tower.
At the top of the wall stair at home, Vexana's father pointed out over the dead ground.
Rain sweeps its broken streets.
It stands on a rise beyond the dome, over the dead ground.
Its stair has no rail and half its steps.
Vexana spends the whole night before the attack there, watching the Academy.
For weeks Vexana watched the city from it, beyond the beep's reach.

ties.t: It stands over the dead ground.

facts.t: The Will orders Vexana there at night: "The ruins east of the dome. Tonight."
Vexana's memories hold fireworks at the edge of a dome.
The Will orders Vexana there before dawn.
The Will sends her there again on the night before the attack.
Under the fireworks there, Guinevere held Vexana's hand and pointed at the sky.
Vexana climbed it at home behind her father, and at the top he pointed over the dead ground.
Vexana's father hummed his march there.
It holds the photo in its thin black frame, the finished felt dolls with the card, her father's screwdriver in the toolbox and the empty white box.
Vexana thinks someone will have to clear it.
On one of the last nights she slept in it, she looked at their photo on her phone with the white box open on the desk.
Since the day at the park, Vexana put the pink keychain in the white box every night.
At a stall there Guinevere pressed the keychain into Vexana's palm.
A city roof under a clear blue sky, with green guardrails warm from the sun, where Guinevere gave Vexana the two gold stars.
There they promised to protect the world, the two of them.
There Guinevere laid out Plan A and Plan B, the day Vexana told her about the paper, until the siren went.
There Vexana said, "The paper never says two. But I think two would shine brighter."
Vexana's memories hold a tree, and a head in her lap.
Vexana realizes the Will had seen the rooftop and the tree in her memories.
The Matrix's eyes once looked down at Vexana out of the torn sky over the tree.
Under it on a clear day Guinevere told a story with her head in Vexana's lap. In Vexana's memory now the sky stays blue.

things.name: the street at the dome's foot

facts.t: Guinevere took this street alone, and a claw raked her right arm. When she opened her eyes, Vexana stood over her holding out a hand.
Vexana said to her there, "Stay with me, Guinevere."
There they fought back to back for the first time, and the street held.
Guinevere repeats Vexana's words from that street on the platform.
Hester drilled Guinevere in its yard at dawn.
Angela remembers the dark there, a child crying, and androids with her face lying around her in the smoke.
There she called Ruby's name and the red went out of Ruby's eye.
Years ago, while every defender ran to the swarms, one giant walked through the middle of the city and the blow fell on the base by the water. Lesley came too late.
The throne is the Storm Citadel's spine. It comes up out of the floor and runs into the dark of the roof, and every block of the ship hangs from it.
It hums, low and even, and Obsidia sits where a neck would be.
Obsidia's field lies asleep in its hum, to be let out through the spine.
Obsidia lays her palm flat on the spine to move the ship.
At her word its hum rises and changes its note.

ties.t: It is the ship's spine.

facts.t: When Obsidia lifts a hand it comes to her across the hall and hangs at her shoulder, its point toward the dark, untouched.
Obsidia built it because her storm could not touch cores lit by belief.
It lies asleep in the hum under her throne. Let out through the spine it would spread over the whole city, and wherever it reached aspirant power would go out, and nothing else.
It grew from the light her Enders died of, from Selena's reports and from the dead suit on her prow. Selena's numbers told her how hard it must press.
For weeks Obsidia laid the hum on the dead suit until it went only into the core and left plate and metal alone.
Obsidia waits behind the mouth with the field ready.

ties.t: Obsidia built it.
It sleeps in the throne's hum.

facts.t: A dead suit sits on Obsidia's prow, one of the sources her field grew from.
Its core is where a pilot's belief once burned. Obsidia tested the field on it for weeks.

ties.t: It sits on the prow.

facts.t: Loosed on a city, it kills machines that run on current while it hangs over them. A core lit by belief runs on none, so the storm cannot touch it.
It runs ahead of the Citadel and comes through the crack a little at a time: clouds, lightning and rain on the bay.
From the city it looks like any other storm.
Cloud pours through the crack into the sky over the bay with lightning in it.
On Joe's last slide every machine under it had died, but on the eve of the attack the city's lamps still burn.
Vexana thinks this is only its weather, and the ship is still behind the sky.
It does not stop all night, yet not one screen in the glass lab flickers.
Chang'e matches its readings to an old film and calls it the Storm Citadel's storm.
Violet light moves inside its black cloud over the water.
Lesley says the records say it kills every machine under it, yet every post reports clean.
Lesley last saw that violet from a windowsill, as a radio downstairs stopped in the middle of a word.
Chang'e says it is only the edge of it.
When the Mother Matrix steps out whole, the clouds tear apart and clear.

ties.t: It is Obsidia's storm.
It is the Citadel's storm, hung around its blades.

facts.t: Obsidia's first recall went down the pulse soon after she learned Selena's name.
Obsidia will send one last call that carries where she sits, once Selena shows her own form.
For weeks it has burned in Selena's cells, pulling her toward the sky over the bay. Now it pulls from the open mouth.
It also buzzes on Selena's phone, red, with no sender.
Selena knows the huntress is behind its pull.

ties.t: Obsidia sends it.

facts.t: It has been silent for days since Obsidia stopped paying.
Two more reports came up it unpaid, then it went still.

ties.t: Selena sends her reports up it.

facts.t: It showed Obsidia that Selena crossed her city to the Academy that morning.
On the next storm night it put Selena on her tower over the Academy, then on a roof at the far edge of the city, then back.
Obsidia sees a city under its dome through the crack.
The humans once broke the body's army at a hole in their dome.
Inside the shell the city stays lit, street after street.
It is the energy shell over all of Terrinia. Until the attack an army had to claw its way in from outside.
The Singularity tears it open over the waterfront.
The Energy System's beam feeds it, but the hole over the water does not close.
Chang'e says it cannot hold against a door that size.

ties.t: It shields all of Terrinia.

facts.t: The Academy's beam climbs into the cloud on the night before the attack.
It stands on the Academy's tallest tower. Its rings spin faster and its white-cyan beam feeds the dome.

ties.t: It stands on the Academy's tallest tower.
Its beam feeds the dome.

facts.t: Vexana's star has been lit since her first hour in the dark. Obsidia first saw it the night her ship came through.
Vexana keeps hers pinned inside her sleeve.
Vexana's star is lit on her right wrist when she wakes.
Every night since the park Vexana put hers in the white box beside the keychain.
Guinevere wears a small gold star at her collar. It is called the Emblem of Hope.
Weeks ago Angela held it while Ruby ran code to make it a tracker. Near or far, its glow never changed.
Ruby says it only says yes. Angela answers that yes is something.
At the attendance wall Guinevere's starts flashing under her fingers.
Its beep had not come once since the day Vexana was taken.
Its beep has a reach. Vexana watched from beyond it for weeks.
Vexana's beeps inside her sleeve when she comes close, and Guinevere's answers across the courtyard.
Fanny knows the beep as the pair's sound.
Only one person in the world can make Guinevere's beep.
Guinevere made the two stars herself, with band-aids on her fingertips, one seam a hair crooked.
Guinevere said they light up when their powers are in sync.
Vexana's glows gold through her sleeve when they face each other.
It burns because the two are still in sync, and Vexana cannot stop that, not even to hide Guinevere.
At the reunion Guinevere's flares as bright as it was on the fireworks night.
At the end both stars are still lit.

ties.t: Guinevere made the two stars herself.

facts.t: A pink-haired keychain with a little face lies on Vexana's folded uniform in the void.
Every night since the park it went into the white box on Vexana's desk with her star.
On the eve of the attack Vexana clips it inside her sleeve against her wrist, beside the star.
Guinevere pressed it into Vexana's palm at the stall: "Now you have me on yours."
At Lesley's speech each girl wore a tiny keychain doll of the other at her belt.
It lies against Vexana's skin beside the star when the Will's mark lets go.
Vexana once laid it in the white box for the night with her star beside it.
A tiny black-haired Vexana on Guinevere's arm guard, clipped there at the end of the first week Vexana was gone, where her fist would swing.
It swings on its clip as Guinevere reaches up while falling.
It swings from her cracked arm guard when Angela pulls her in.
Two finished felt dolls stand beside the photo in Vexana's room, with a card under them.
One has pink hair and one black hair.

ties.t: They stand in Vexana's room.

facts.t: It lies under the felt dolls and reads: For Guinevere. Same place, next year.
Vexana hopes Guinevere will read it.
It is written in Vexana's small square letters and waits for next summer.

ties.t: It lies under the dolls.

facts.t: A photo in a thin black frame shows Vexana and Guinevere hand in hand.
Vexana looked at their photo on her phone on one of her last nights in her room.

ties.t: It stands in Vexana's room.

facts.t: It stands on Vexana's desk. Each night she put the keychain and her star in it.
It sits empty in her room, with no keychain in it.
It holds what Guinevere gave her: ticket stubs, a paper fan and the napkin from the doughnut.

ties.t: It sits in Vexana's room.

facts.t: Vexana's father's screwdriver lies wiped clean in its place in the toolbox in her room.
At the team test Vexana fitted the brass collar to her staff with a little screwdriver.
Vexana tries it with her fingers the way her father tried each sight on the wall. It does not give.
It is a band of brass around the staff's cracked grip.
Vexana fitted it at the team test, kneeling behind Guinevere with a little screwdriver while Guinevere held the front alone.
Vexana's thumb finds it on the grip, where it always sits.

ties.t: It rings the staff's grip.

facts.t: It ends in an orb as dark as a hole in the world.
It fires a huge arrow of violet light.
A great spell gathers in it while Guinevere runs, and throws her off the platform.
Vexana breaks the Guard's fused chest plate with its butt.
Vexana pulls all her power into its orb until it holds a hard dark-pink knot.
The knot goes out when she takes Guinevere's hand.
Its orb is dark again as they climb.
At the end of the fight over the gap it went past Guinevere's ear, close enough to hear it hum.
It lies folded beside Vexana in the void.
She leaves it folded square, because in the vision she wore it and Guinevere fell anyway.
She waited in it by the door at Lesley's speech.
Vexana lights it by laying her palm on its chest over the heart. Its yellow eyes light and its heart blazes magenta.
She knows each of its plates by the dents her hammer left.
Its plate is purple edged in gold, with a magenta heart crest on its chest. It waits folded and dark behind a chimney.
It drops out of the smoke between the wall and the Matrix's beam with its arms up.
It leans into the beam and holds while the light melts the road around it.
Its eyes go dark one after the other.
Vexana sees through its eyes from inside.
It ran on her belief and spent all of it on one block.
Its plates fused at the seams, and Vexana cracked the chest plate open to get out.
It kneels against the wall, dark, its chest plate split down the middle and the edges bent outward.
Vexana lit it, went inside its open heart, and dropped it into the light.

ties.t: Vexana built it.
It takes the Matrix's shot for her.
It is the lead one of the Guards.

facts.t: Two cat-eared drones ride at Guinevere's shoulders.
Their yellow eyes burn as they snap up at her shoulders.
They take whatever her hands leave.
As her power runs low they hang lower and their eyes go dull.
One tumbles past her, dark, when she falls.
One circles slowly and the other hangs low with its eye dark.
The dark one lights yellow again as she goes through Angela's pane.
They fling themselves in front of the Matrix's beam.
They drop onto the stone, dark and smoking.
They lift again, trailing smoke, and find her shoulders.
They take the Enders that come high.

ties.t: They shield her from the beam.

facts.t: She carries it on her shoulder on the deck.
Its bolt sits under the coil, the old action.
It has been on Ruby since the day Ruby landed.
No rifle could cross the range to the Matrix.
A long cannon catches the lightning in the courtyard ranks.
Layla carries it on her shoulder.
It roars as Layla answers the deck.
Its shot is a thin cyan line.
Ruby carries it on her shoulder.
Lightning crawls down its blade, and one swing splits the ring of Enders.
It keeps sending the Enders back over the rail.
Fanny's hand goes to her blade when the figure appears.
Her blades go through a pane in the shield.
Her arcs follow Layla's shot up to the crown.
Rear support holds it just behind the frontline.
It stands around the four of them as a bell of pink light.
Angela opens panes in it for shots and closes them before the next claw.
It dims where claws dig in.
It swells and throws the nearest Enders back across the stones.
It stands pink and bright over the four on the platform.
A shaking film from the Academy's oldest records, of a ship of black blades over a city in a red sky, with storm readings taken with it.
Chang'e lays the day's readings over its readings, and the two lines sit one on top of the other.

ties.t: It is in the Academy's oldest records.

facts.t: It is Chang'e's file on the void, still marked working on it.
It matches the large incoming line at three points.
The big slow line it matched goes off the top of the scale.
A faint trace matches nothing, not even these notes.

ties.t: It is Chang'e's own file.

facts.t: Vexana found it in the Academy library, the third paper on the void, with Teacher Chang'e's name and "Status: untested." It says an Aspirant's light would go on shining inside a black hole and find its way home.
Vexana does not know if it is true. Nobody does.
Vexana told Guinevere about it on the green-railed roof.
Vexana said it never says two, but she thought two would shine brighter.

ties.t: It has Chang'e's name on it.

facts.t: It lies open beside Ruby's console in Guinevere's hand. Most lines say Nothing, and the last say Point over the bay. Faint. No change.
Guinevere writes Flashing in it.

ties.t: Guinevere writes it.

facts.t: It stands in the glass lab with a lamp beside it.
Through it Guinevere sees the far light burn magenta and flash.
It is linked to a screen at Ruby's console.

ties.t: It stands in the glass lab.

facts.t: Ruby and Angela keep it running in the tower.
Its readings over the bay have not held still since the point came out, and Angela repairs an open panel.
Angela says the energy readings are still unstable and the repair is going slowly.

ties.t: It is the tower's array.

facts.t: On Selena's phone it shows the point over the bay and a graph climbing.
It shows the Singularity as a four-pointed rift and a small figure flying at it.
Guinevere's face fills it, wet and set.
It switches to a city map with a red zone over the waterfront and the platforms.
Students stand packed under it.

ties.t: It hangs in the hall.

facts.t: Students crowd the corridor under it between classes.
It shows the day's attendance record, a long list of names in white.
It lists Vexana: Absent, in red.
Everyone crowds it when the alarm goes.

ties.t: It stands in an Academy corridor.

facts.t: The Academy's files say Missing, while the wall says only Absent.
Lesley entered the word herself beside Vexana's name on the morning list every morning since the capture.
Chang'e notes that it says Missing.
Lesley rules it stays Missing.
It shows Guinevere and Vexana in the courtyard.
On it they stand back to back, and Vexana's hair is long and black.
Professor Joe once pointed his cane at it.

ties.t: It hangs over the courtyard.

facts.t: Lesley keys it and orders all posts to report.
Lesley does not know why it holds under the storm.
The posts go out over it.
Voices come over it one on top of another.
The word "Traitor" goes down it faster than any order.
It goes silent when Guinevere's signal is lost.
It breaks its silence when the west ward asks what took the shot.
Guinevere's line on it is open, and Layla hears every word.
A second line climbs on it behind the first wave, slow and larger than anything it has shown.
Its map shows the red marks come in at the waterfront and turn inland.
Down one side runs a column of thin lines, one for the power of every suit in the city.
The lines fall all at once, frontline and rear.
Guinevere's point on its map drops into the gap and is gone.
The lines stop falling, though none climbs yet.

ties.t: It sits on the command deck.

facts.t: The dead suit's core is where a pilot's belief once burned.
Students in suits stand in the frontline ranks.
Layla, Fanny, Ruby and Angela wore combat suits at Lesley's speech.
Every suit in the city sends its power to the deck. The suits run on belief, so their lines are as close as anyone comes to reading it.
Lesley thinks you do not have to shoot a suit that runs on belief.
Vexana knows the city's suits run on belief.
On it Lesley and Chang'e watch Guinevere and Vexana face each other.
It goes white when the two clash.
Chang'e brings up the ward camera on the street three streets west.
On the street camera the lead Guard drops out of the smoke.
A long scream of plate comes out of its speaker.
A tall frame beside the main gate that fills with light. Step in, and it puts you out where the fight is.

ties.t: It stands beside the main gate.

facts.t: They open out of thin air over the waterfront, and Enders leap through them.
Enders keep dropping out of them onto the roofs and streets.
Doors cost the Will dearly inside the humans' dome.
The doors Vexana comes home through are the Will's.
The dark opens in front of Vexana and she steps through.
Before first light the door opens behind her, as it always does.
The door takes her back into the dark.
For weeks they opened through the cold point in Vexana, always where the Will sent her, never where she chose.
Vexana opens one herself under the falling Guinevere, no wider than her arms.
It gives three heartbeats of cold and no sound.

ties.t: They are the Will's doors.

facts.t: Guinevere's Plan A was to smash the Core and win.
Guinevere never found it, and Obsidia had never even seen it.
Four Guards stand dark over Vexana after she sleeps in the void.
When she lights the lead Guard, the giants' eyes light after it, high in the dark.
She lets them go dark, the giants first, to save her power for the body.
Vexana thinks the Guards will still be standing over Guinevere after she is gone.
Vexana's own machines came through with her, and she calls them her Eternal Guards.
They need her power poured into them without a break.
They would never turn on her.

ties.t: Vexana built them and hammered their plates.
They would never turn on her.

facts.t: Three giants wait folded and dark on the high ledges over the platforms, swords across their knees, ready to drop at her hand.
One drops out of the smoke with a sword taller than a house and smashes Guinevere's platform. Guinevere takes it for a giant Ender.
All three rise out of the smoke around Vexana, their swords dragging sparks.
After the clash they lie still in the rubble under the platforms.
Their swords lie on the stones beside them as Vexana reaches for them with her power.
One pair of eyes flickers yellow and goes out.
Vexana lets them go.

ties.t: They are three of the four Guards.

facts.t: The Will names Vexana "of The Aspirants."
A student wonders what the Aspirants plan to do about the Singularity.
A voice from everywhere says the Aspirants will soon meet their end.
Guinevere calls, "Aspirants! Today, our light shall pierce the Singularity!"
Everyone on the platform says, "The Aspirants always stand united!"
Teacher Chang'e's paper says an Aspirant's light would go on shining inside a black hole.
To Obsidia they are a people with nothing to fight the cycle with.
They began to fight back with what they believed, which no people on any world she watched end had done. Since then more raids have failed than not.
They learn, and year by year they kill her Enders faster.
The Storm Citadel was sent to crush humanity's resistance once and for all.
Selena refuses to die for humanity.
Vexana strikes the Matrix for humanity.

ties.t: The body's raids came down on them for years.

facts.t: The students call the point over the bay the Singularity.
The class laughs at Selena's line about graduation. Even the teacher's mouth twitches.
A boy reads from his tablet that an abnormal signal from the Singularity could be an Ender invasion.
A girl wonders what the Aspirants plan to do, and glances at Guinevere.
Someone says behind Guinevere, "She still thinks that thing means she's alive."
Students in suits stand in the frontline ranks.
They pack the dark of the hall under the big display.
The word "Traitor" comes first from them in the hall.

ties.t: They crowd the Academy's corridor.

facts.t: Lesley orders the Shield reserves to hold their wards, and they answer one by one.
Shield soldiers stand in ranks with the frontline in the courtyard.
They swing their rifles up at the figure on the roof.
Fanny orders the Shield squad to hold the courtyard.
Fanny thinks of holding the line and sending a squad as the Shield's way.
Chang'e posts Fanny, Layla and Guinevere to frontline assault, to meet the Enders head on.
It forms in the courtyard: Shield soldiers, students in suits and a long cannon.
Lesley sends it on Layla's plan.
Chang'e calls it my division, and says Selena's machine is the fastest in it.

ties.t: Chang'e speaks of it as hers.

things.name: wall guns
things.sub: gun crews of the west ward

facts.t: The wall guns of the west ward ask permission to fire on the woman on the platform, and Lesley tells them to hold.
The west ward asks over the channel what took the Matrix's shot.
Lesley orders all posts to report.
The gate reports clear.
The infirmary reports clear.
Every voice comes back clean under the storm.
They run for the main gate and the gate portal.
Lesley keys the rescue team and sends Layla to Guinevere.
They could not get through the Enders to her.
Fanny, Layla, Ruby and Angela come up the stair to the platform.
The humans fight back with what they believe.
A core lit by belief runs on no current, so Obsidia's storm cannot touch it.
Obsidia's field would put out aspirant power wherever it reached.
Its light is what the Enders die of.
The suits run on belief, so their power lines are as close as anyone comes to reading it.
Lesley thinks a line shown its best fighter on the other side stops believing it can win.
Guinevere and Vexana open wings of aspirant power.
The lead Guard ran on Vexana's belief.
Guinevere's wings of light open and she shoots after the figure.
Wings of aspirant power open on both Guinevere and Vexana.
Guinevere's go out when her power is spent, and she falls.
Guinevere's come thin and flickering, but they hold.
They open on both girls, one light gold and one violet.
The black hole bends Guinevere's wings toward it.
Vexana's thin to threads of violet after the strike.
A cold point under Vexana's breastbone stirs before the Will's orders.
Because of it the Enders run with Vexana as if she led them.
On the platform it lets go.
For weeks it sat in her chest. It goes the way a hand lets go of a tool it has finished with.
The Will's doors opened through it.
Vexana pushed at it with everything she was to open a door herself, and something tore.
A voice from everywhere orders, "Vexana. Execute purge protocol."
To purge a place is to wipe it clean.
Guinevere takes it as an order to kill her.
Vexana sees it as a trap: kill her partner, or show her side. Either way the Will wins.
Vexana wanted the Will to think the purge was done.

ties.t: Obsidia reads that the Will planned one order with Guinevere in front of Vexana.

facts.t: An Ender's chest opens as it strikes, and a shot into it kills.
Vexana calls it the first rule of Enders: when one fires, its plates split and the core is bare.
Vexana says of the Matrix, "It opens when it fires. Only then."
In Joe's class Layla called the weak spot obvious: when it attacks.
Obsidia said of something she had made, "If it ever slips beyond control, there is only one outcome."
Vexana answered "Termination," and even then heard it about herself.
Obsidia thinks the rule she spoke among the rows will do the rest once the Will has used Vexana.
To Obsidia every raid was the cycle working on a people with nothing to fight it with.
If the body finishes the humans, Obsidia will watch the old ending hold.
She wants to see a different ending.
Obsidia thinks even the storm night was for the seed, and that afterward her hand would only spoil what grew.

ties.t: Obsidia says the storm night was for it.

facts.t: Obsidia calls the day of the attack the final stage of her experiment. Under every plan lies one want: to see a different ending.
Obsidia's first recall to Selena went down it.
Obsidia reads back along it to learn the Will's moves.
What the Will said to Vexana in the vision went down it like any order.
Obsidia finds Vexana's memories in it too.
Guinevere says, "Plan A first."
On the green-railed roof Guinevere laid it out: she smashes the Core and they win.
They never found the Core, so the open chest is the one blow left.
Vexana says, "This is Plan A," and gives no more.
Plan B is that they come home. Guinevere made Vexana say "Plan B" out loud.
Guinevere notices that Vexana did not say Plan B.
As the black hole takes them, Vexana says "Plan B" without being asked.
Guinevere's light flares up gold at the words.
Chang'e posts Selena to mobile support.
Mobile support goes wherever the fight bends.
Its light on the panel keeps blinking when nobody answers.
Fanny takes it for a spotter's post in the best seat in the city.
Chang'e posts Ruby and Angela to rear support.
It holds the ground just behind the frontline: Angela's shield, the wounded, the way out.
Lesley tells it to stay on the frontline's heels.
Obsidia thinks even the storm night was for the seed.
On the storm night Obsidia carried Selena out of the nest and down herself.
Obsidia reads in the pulse that it was the Will's first move once the body began its door: take one of the two girls who fought as one, and the other breaks.
A door opened in a corridor of the Academy. The Will reached for the girl with her back to the door, the other stepped in front of her, and either one served.
The Emblem's beep had not come once since the day Vexana was taken.
At the end of the first week after it, Guinevere clipped the black-haired keychain to her arm guard.
Lesley has marked Vexana Missing every morning since the capture.
What the Will said in it went down the pulse like any order.
The Will said, "Vexana of The Aspirants, you have reached the end of your future."
It named her side before it named her end.
In it Vexana wore her uniform, and Guinevere fell anyway.
In it Guinevere lay broken among the others.
Vexana fears that if Guinevere comes with the whole frontline, they will all stand under the gateway together when the Matrix comes, as in the vision.
Vexana tells Guinevere she has seen the end that awaits them.
The Ultimate Enders in the holds have their chests packed with lesser Enders and new, heavier plate over their shoulders.
