Obsidia says, "Augmentation approved."
The chests swing shut, ready for the morning.
The Singularity tears open over the bay and the morning goes dark as dusk.
The alarm goes up through the tower and sirens answer in every ward.
Enders come through purple portals inside the dome. Until then an army had to claw its way in from outside.
Every Ender turns inland for the Academy's wards.
Vexana brings the first wave down on the emptied waterfront warehouses.
The Mother Matrix comes halfway through the sky over the platforms.
Nearly half the city is rubble.
The Mother Matrix steps out whole.
Struck in the chest, the Matrix staggers back into the light at the star's edge.
Layla marks weak points in green on her tablet and says the rescue operation is ready to go.
Lesley sends the frontline on Layla's plan, with rear support on their heels.
Fanny tells Layla to lead.
Lesley tells Layla where Guinevere is and to get to her if she can.
The team could not break through to her.
Wings of aspirant power open on both of them and they rise at each other.
Light bursts white and gold between them.
Guinevere falls, her wings gone out.
Falling, she says, "Don't let me be alone in this world."
Vexana turned her staff aside at the last meter.
Guinevere's hand was open, never a fist, and the staff went past her ear. They passed so close their wings brushed.
No blow landed on either of them.
Vexana dived, opened a door of the void under Guinevere and caught her wrist.
She laid Guinevere behind a low wall three streets west.
Guinevere realizes later that Vexana missed on purpose.

things.name: the Guard's block
things.sub: the lead Guard takes the Matrix's shot

facts.t: The Mother Matrix fires at Guinevere behind the wall.
A machine of purple plate edged in gold drops between the wall and the light with its arms up.
It holds while the beam melts the road to glass on either side.
Chang'e says it is not one of the Enders'.
It spent all of Vexana's belief on one block.
Vexana thinks: it held, and that was enough.
Guinevere half remembers a back between her and the glare, and metal shrieking.
Guinevere tells the others a machine took the Matrix's shot for her.
The Enders ring Vexana on the platform.
When the Will's mark lets go, the ring closes in to kill.
She fights them with one arm, shot by shot.
She says "Dissolve into the dark of night" and shoots a tall Ender through the chest.
The last Ender falls across her boots.
The fight takes all the power she had gathered.

things.name: the stand in the street by the wall

facts.t: Vexana's father once stood in a street by the wall with one Ender in front of him and his daughter behind.
A soldier told Vexana at her cot that the Ender never got past him, not while he stood.
Guinevere drops between Vexana and the Matrix, crosses her arms, and her drones fling themselves in front of her.
The light hits the drones first and her second. Her boots slide back and stop, and she holds.
The light dies and the Matrix's plates close.
Vexana's chance at the open chest passes while Guinevere's back stands between them.
Guinevere crouches and holds out her hand, palm up.
She says, "Stay with me, Vexana."
Vexana takes the hand with her burned hand and does not let go.
Guinevere says, "As long as we're together!"
Layla lowers her cannon: "It's not a trap."
Vexana cries "Hope never dies!"
Everyone, Fanny too, says "The Aspirants always stand united!"
The two rise side by side toward the crowned head.

things.name: the strike on the open chest
things.sub: the double strike on the Matrix

facts.t: Layla's plan is to draw the Matrix's fire onto the shield so its chest opens away from the two girls.
Layla's shot and Fanny's arcs strike the crowned head.
The Matrix turns to the platform and its chest plates split.
Guinevere and Vexana dive in, their two lights crossing, a gold star and a violet one.
Guinevere cries, "This strike is for Vexana."
Vexana cries, "This strike is for Guinevere!"
They strike the open chest together, her fist beside Vexana's staff.
Light breaks out of the wound, and the shot that was gathering never leaves.
The Matrix staggers back into the light with its chest plates grinding shut.

things.name: the black hole takes them
things.sub: end of Guinevere and Vexana's strike

facts.t: After the strike the two are inside the black point's reach.
It takes hold of Vexana, and she has nothing left to fight it with.
Guinevere goes the same way, her light thinned to a faint gold outline.
Vexana says, "Plan B."
Guinevere's light flares up gold.
The dark takes them both.
At the team test, Vexana knelt behind Guinevere and fitted the brass collar to her staff with a little screwdriver while Guinevere held the front alone.
Lesley gave a speech about trust to Layla, Fanny, Ruby and Angela in their combat suits, in the hall under the five great stars.
On its last words Guinevere waved at Vexana with her whole arm, and afterward towed her out by the sleeve.
Guinevere reminds Vexana, "We made a promise to protect this world."
On a city roof with green guardrails Guinevere held out two gold stars she had made herself.
She took a phone photo of the two of them, a gold star glowing at each collar.
She said, "We protect this world. The two of us," and Vexana said, "A promise."
On the day of the badges, Vexana reached over without a word to straighten Guinevere's crooked bow, and the whole hall cheered while their hands were clasped.

things.name: the fireworks at the dome's edge

facts.t: The Will saw fireworks at the edge of a dome in Vexana's memories.
Vexana told Obsidia, "Someone told me once that we'd be like fireworks."
Under the fireworks Vexana told herself, "Don't get used to this," about her smile.
That night the Emblem shone very bright.
Under the fireworks Guinevere pointed at the sky and said, "We'll be just like fireworks, shining at our absolute brightest!"
After curfew Guinevere pulled Vexana down a corridor by the hand, lamps on Guinevere's side, dark on hers, against every rule Vexana kept.
Once in sparring Guinevere caught Vexana's wrist and found a bandage with blood on it under the glove. Vexana had told no one.
Vexana said only, "It was mine to carry."
Through it Guinevere said at the long table and in the counseling room that Vexana was alive.
Angela said at the long table, "I came back once. People come back."
All through it the Emblem stayed lit.
On the eve of the attack the hour of the call comes and goes.
On late nights Guinevere bargained: "Ten more." Vexana said, "Go to bed." Guinevere said, "Five. You can count them."
Vexana still knows the phone number by heart, in gold ink, underlined twice: For emergencies. Or anything.
To Vexana, "Go to bed" means goodnight and promises another night.
Every night, late, Vexana's voice came down the phone to tell Guinevere "Go to bed."
